tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅/ dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub zhal snga nas brgyud pa'i sgrol ma g.yul bzlog bltas chog tu bkod pa bden 'bras myur ston

ces bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru ār+ya tā ra ye/ dpa' zhing glog ltar myur ba'i thugs rje'i spyan// mkha' khyab sdug bsngal yid can la gzigs pas// skad cig re rer rnam grol bde ba cher// dbugs 'byin stsol mdzad rje btsun 'phags mar 'dud// gang de'i rnal 'byor la brten nas// phyi nang bar chad bzlog pa'i thabs// khungs ldan byin rlabs gzi brjid can// 'khrul med gong ma'i lung bzhin 'god// rgyal ba gnyis pa 'phags mchog klu sgrub zhal nas rim par brgyud cing 'phags bod kyi ljongs na yongs su grags pa'i mdos zlog 'di la don bzhi/ gang las brgyud pa'i tshul/ phan yon dang 'brel ba'i lo rgyus/ sgrub pa po'i gang zag /cho ga dngos lag tu len pa'i tshul lo// dang po ni/ rgyal bas lung bstan cing sgrol ma'i rgyud la brten nas grub pa thob pa 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi mdzad de skal ldan rnams la gnang*/ de nas brgyud pa'i zam ma chad par byon te jo bo a ti shas bod du bsnams/ jo bos sku gshegs khar na bza'i gseb nas bton te dge bshes ston pa la gnang*/ des gsang phu rngog legs pa'i shes rab/ des sne zur pa la gnang zhing rim par brgyud nas rgya ston la bka' babs te yig cha rgyas pa'ang mdzad/ phyis rgyal tshab grags pa mchog dbyangs dang zhu chen sogs kyis yig cha lag len rgyas bsdus ci rigs par mdzad cing lung dang lag len gyi brgyud pa'ang ma nyams par bzhugs pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi zhal nas/ ye shes lha dang 'jig rten pa// de dag nus pa 'di yis zhi// klu rgyal gtsug gi nor bu bzhin// dgos 'dod thams cad 'di yis 'grub// rten gsum 'og tu mnan pa dang*// sde brgyad dag la gtad pa dang*// zor thun phur pa bsgril ba dang*// yul du ltas ngan skyes pa sogs// de dag kun gyi nus pa ni// cung zad tsam yang 'byin mi nus// rang nyid bsgrub na mchog tu bsngags// zhes gdams pa dang*/

jo bo'i zhal nas/ thag ring por 'gro na cho ga 'di byas pas rkyen ngan gang yang mi 'byung ngo*// yang yul phyogs su 'khrug pa yod pa dang*/ nad rims g.yos pa dang*/ mi dge ba'i ltas byung ba la cho ga 'dis zlog go /rang la mi 'dod pa ci byung yang the tshom mi byed par cho ga 'di bgyis pas rang la ci 'dod pa'i don mi 'grub mi srid/ 'dod pa'i don 'grub pa dang zlog pa'i cho ga 'di las byin rlabs che ba dang mthu che ba med pas/ 'di la shin tu brtson par gyis shig /bod du thon pa'i yig cha 'di las zab pa med par 'dug gsungs so// des na mthu dang byad kha than ltas rmi lam ngan pa/ lha 'dre drag po dang 'gras pa/ gdon chen gyi gnod pa zug pa/ dal yams rims nad/ god kha phyugs nad/ lo zla zhag dus gza' skar ngan pa'i gnod pa sogs gang la'ang zlog pa 'di zab cing stobs che/ gzhan yang drag sngags bgrang ba dang*/ mna' zos pa dang*/ thag ring 'gro ba'i nyes pa sogs kyang sgrib cing mdor na ye shes pa dang 'jig rten pa thams cad kyis nus mthu zlog pa'i nyes pa thams cad zlog cing dge legs thams cad spel ba la khyad par du 'phags pa'o// de lta bu'i byin rlabs phan yon chen po dang ldan pa'i cho ga 'di nyid byas pas yid ches pa'i rtags rgya gar dang bal po bod rnams las byung ba'i lo rgyus rgya cher 'dug pa ni yig rnying rnams las shes par bya'o// gsum pa ni/ sgrol ma'i dbang dang rjes gnang gang rung thob pa/ phyag 'tshal nyi shu rtsa gcig gi lung thob cing khyad par du tshul 'di'i lung thob pa'i rab dge slong*/ 'bring dge tshul/ tha na dge bsnyen yang rung ste/ khyim pa ma yin pa nyi shu rtsa gcig gam/ bdun nam/ lnga'am/ gcig gam/ gsum la sogs pa yul dus dang 'tshams pas bsgrub bo// bzhi pa cho ga dngos la gsum/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes kyi bya ba'o// dang po ni/ dus bzang po'am dgos pa la bab pa'i tshe/

gnas khang byi dor byas pa'i gung du stegs bu mtho zhing khebs ldan gyi dbus su rdul tshon nam ras bris kyi pad+ma 'dab ma nyi shu pa lte ba dang bcas pa bkod/ ma 'byor na maṇ+ḍal la 'bru'i tshom bu dbus su gcig mtha' skor phyogs bzhir lnga re ste nyer gcig tshang bar bkod pa'i steng sgrol ma nyer gcig gam/ sgrol ljang gi sku bris 'bur gang rung rab gnas can bkod/ de'i mdun du phyi mchod phreng tshar/ khrus bum/ sku phyis na bza' rnams dang*/ snod gtsang mar gtor zlum theb kyu mang pos bskor ba rgyan spros can bcas gtsang sbra dang ldan par bsham/ de dag las dma' ba'i stegs bur bgegs gtor cog rdog ril bu spungs pa dang*/ lan chags gtor ma/ ngar chung changs bu ting lo theb kyu bcas pa dang*/ gzhi bdag la dkar gtor 'bru sna blugs pa bcas bsham mo// de nas mdos zlog ni/ stegs bu gru bzhi pa'i steng du zan nam 'jim pa'i ri rab bang rim bzhi pa bya/ ri rab kyi steng du mkhar thabs gru bzhi rgya phib tog dang bcas pa mdzes tshon byas la bzhag /mkhar gyi sgo mdun gyi bang rim gong ma la zan gyi ngar mi mtho gang rta la zhon pa gcig bzhag /de la gser g.yu dar zab gos kyis brgyan/ zan la gser skyems brdar ba'i mi'u thung gi gzugs sum cu lag bzo'am/ spar btab pa gang bder byas la bang rim dang po'i mkhar gyi mtha' bskor du bzhag /ngar mi che ba rta can gyi g.yas g.yon rgyab gsum du nam mkha' gsum btsug /mdun du rgyang bu gsum btsug /bang rim gnyis par zhal zas brgyad dang bya rigs sna tshogs kyis bskor ba/ bang rim gsum par glang chen rta mdzo ba glang ra lug sogs dud 'gro'i rigs kyi gzugs brnyan dang*/ sha gna' sgo sogs ri dwags kyi rigs thams cad kyi gzugs brnyan dang*/ nya lcong sbal sbrul sogs chu gnas sna tshogs kyi gzugs brnyan 'god/ bang rim bzhi pa'i phyogs bzhi dang zur bzhir mar me re re ste brgyad/

'bru sna tshogs dang zas sna nor g.yu'i rigs gang 'dzom/ sman sna 'bru sna ngar mi changs bu gos dum bu glud gzugs lhag ma'i rigs dang*/ than ltas sogs byung ba yin na gang byung ba'i gzugs brnyan dang yas stag sogs kyi rigs ci 'dzoms pas bskor/ mtha' lcags ris bskor ba'i g.yas kyi khar pho gdong drug /g.yon du mo gdong drug /mdun du mda' bkra gsum/ rgyab tu 'phang bkra gsum/ phyogs bzhir nam mkha' bzhi/ mtshams bzhir rgyang bu bzhi rnams btsug /de'i phyi nas snal mas bcings te mdun du mdud pa kha tshur rang la bstan te bzhag go /bca' lugs de bzhin yig rnying nas bshad pa dang dam pa kha cig gi phyag bzhes su snang bas khungs btsun pa yin la/ spyir gto mdos kyi rigs la mkhas blun dang 'byor pa'i khyad par gyis rgyas bsdus 'dra min rang bzos bya ba mtha' gcig tu ma nges pas 'di la'ang byed lugs sna tshogs su snang ngo*// gnyis pa la lnga*/ bdag bskyed/ mdun bskyed/ mchod bstod gtor 'bul/ glud rdzong*/ bden stobs kyis bzlog pa'o// dang po la/ skyabs sems ni/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o// chos la skyabs su mchi'o// dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o// rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ lan gsum/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma'i bsgom bzlas la 'jug par bgyi'o/ lan gsum/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi sogs lan gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang sogs kyis tshad med bzhi bsgom/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi snying gar a las zla ba'i steng du tām̐ ljang gu/

de'i 'od kyis lus gang*/ rnam smin gdos bcas dang sdig sgrib lhan cig tu sbyangs/ rang nyid sgrol ma'i skur gyur pa ni/ sku mdog ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas mchog sbyin dang g.yon ut+pal sngon po'i rtsa ba thugs kar bzung ba snyan gyi thad kar kha bye ba/ zhabs g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum pa'i skyil krung phyed pa'i rol pas bzhugs pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ pad zla'i gdan la bzhugs par gyur/ thugs kar zla ba la gnas pa'i tām̐ de las 'od zer 'phros/ rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma ye shes sems dpa'i lha tshogs badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ phyag dang mchod pa yid kyis bya zhing ngag nas mi brjod/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan par gyur/ lha sku'i gsal snang la sems bzung*/ bzlas pa ni/ thugs kar zla ba'i steng du tām̐ yig ljang gu'i mtha' bskor du yi ge bcu pas bskor bar bsgoms la/ oṃ tā re tut+tā te tu re swā hā/ zhes pa dang*/ gzungs sngags kyis bskor bar gsal btab la/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo ār+ya a wa lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satwa ya/ ma hā satwa ya/ ma hā ka ru ṇi kā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ/ pra duṣ+ṭaṃ/ ma ma kri te/ dzam bha ya/ s+t+waṃ bha ya/ mo ha ya/ bhan+dha ya/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ s+t+waṃ bha ni tā re swā hā/ zhes pa'ang ci 'grub tu bzlas/ mthar/ ye shes pa mdun du bzhugs par gyur/ ar+ghaṃ nas/ shab+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol mas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ ces 'dod don gsol ba gdab/ dge ba bsngo*/ oṃ muḥ zhes gshegs su gsol/ rang dam tshig pa'i nga rgyal gyis gnas par bya'o// gnyis pa mdun bskyed ni/ oṃ shu n+ya ta dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/

stong pa'i ngang las pām̐ las sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du tām̐ ljang gu las ut+pal tām̐ gyis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das ma rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma sku mdog ljang gu rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis spras pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgyas sems can thams cad kyi bsam pa rdzogs par mdzad pa/ g.yon pas rab tu rgyas pa'i ut+pal 'dzin cing mdzes pa'i dar gyi na bza' bklubs pa/ rgyal ba don yod grub pa'i dbu rgyan can/ pad zla'i gdan la rol pa'i stabs kyis sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pa'i dbus su bzhugs pa/ mtha' bskor gyi pad 'dab nyi shu la mdun nas g.yas bskor gyis rim pa bzhin myur zhing dpa' ba bgegs dang 'tshe ba rnam par 'joms pa'i sgrol ma sku mdog dmar mo dbang du sdud pa'i bum pa dmar po bsnams pa/ ston ka'i zla ba ltar dkar ba nad dang gdon bgegs 'joms pa'i sgrol ma zhi ba'i bum pa dkar po bsnams pa/ tshe dang longs spyod 'phel bar mdzad pa'i sgrol ma gser mdog can rgyas pa'i bum pa ser po bsnams pa/ tshe'i mchog stsol bar mdzad pa'i sgrol ma rnam par rgyal ma gser mdog can tshe'i bum pa ser po bsnams pa/ hūm̐ sgra sgrogs ma shes rab kyi phyag rgyas dbang du sdud par bya zhing 'gugs par mdzad pa'i sgrol ma sku mdog dmar ser yid 'phrog pa'i bum pa dmar po bsnams pa/ 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba 'byung po 'dul bar mdzad pa'i sgrol ma sku mdog dmar nag 'byung po ro langs myos par byed pa'i bum pa sngon po bsnams pa/ gzhan 'joms shing gzhan gyi rig sngags zlog par mdzad pa'i sgrol ma sku mdog nag mo rig sngags zlog pa'i bum pa nag po bsnams pa/ bdud dgra 'joms pa'i sgrol ma sku mdog dmar nag bdud dang dgra 'joms pa'i bum pa dmar po bsnams pa/

dkon mchog gsum mtshon gyi phyag rgya can 'jigs pa thams cad bsrung bar mdzad ma 'jigs pa thams cad 'joms pa'i bum pa dkar po bsnams pa/ bdud dang bar du gcod pa 'dul bar mdzad pa'i sgrol ma sku mdog dmar mo bdud 'joms pa'i bum pa dmar po bsnams pa/ dbul ba'i sdug bsngal sel zhing dngos grub stsol bar mdzad pa'i sgrol ma sku mdog gser btso ma ltar dmar ser dbul ba sel ba'i bum pa ser po bsnams pa/ bkra shis thams cad sbyin par mdzad ma sku mdog gser gyi mdog can bkra shis pa'i bum pa dkar po bsnams pa/ bgegs dang bar chad 'joms par mdzad ma me ltar 'bar ba'i sku mdog dmar mo bar chad srung ba'i bum pa dmar po bsnams pa/ bgegs rnam par 'joms pa'i khro gnyer can gyi sgrol ma sku mdog nag mo khro gnyer cung zad yod pa bgegs la bsnun pa'i bum pa mthing ga bsnams pa/ sdig pa dang sgrib pa sbyong bar mdzad pa'i sgrol ma zhi ba chen mo sku mdog dkar mo sdig sgrib sbyong bar mdzad pa'i bum pa dkar po bsnams pa/ pha rol gyi rtsod pa las rgyal zhing blo gros 'phel bar mdzad pa'i sgrol ma sku mdog dmar mo shes rab 'phel bar mdzad pa'i bum pa dmar ser bsnams pa/ bdud dang bar chad zhi zhing 'jig rten gsum g.yo ba'i sgrol ma sku mdog dmar ser rig sngags gnon pa'i bum pa ser po bsnams pa/ klu yi dug thams cad rab tu zhi zhing sel bar mdzad pa'i sgrol ma sku mdog dkar mo dug nad sel ba'i bum pa dkar po bsnams pa/ rmi lam ngan pa dang sdug bsngal sel bar mdzad pa'i sgrol ma sku mdog dkar mo sdug bsngal sel ba'i bum pa dkar po bsnams pa/ rims nad thams cad sel bar mdzad pa'i sgrol ma sku mdog dkar mo rims nad sel ba'i bum pa dmar po bsnams pa/ phrin las yongs rdzogs kyi sgrol ma sku mdog dkar mo 'od zer sna tshogs 'phro ba dngos grub sna tshogs 'byung ba'i bum pa ljang gu bsnams pa/

thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin gyi mthil na phrin las so so sgrub pa'i bum pa dang*/ phyag g.yon ut+pal bsnams shing pad zla'i gdan la brkyang bskum stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan cing 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phro ba/ mtha' bskor du sangs rgyas byang sems yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba/ de dag thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ de las 'od 'phros pas po ta la nas rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma nyi shu rtsa gcig la sangs rgyas byang sems yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong dpag tu med pas bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes bsdu ba'i phyag rgya dang*/ mthar thal mo sbyar la/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*// bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha// dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i// bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// po ta la yi gnas mchog nas// tām̐ yig ljang gu las 'khrungs shing*// 'od dpag med pas dbu la brgyan// dus gsum sangs rgyas phrin las ma// 'gro ba'i don du gshegs su gsol// zhes brjod/ mdun du bzhugs pa la/ btso ma gser gyi mdog 'dra zhing*// nyi ma las lhag gzi brjid che// dad pas spyan ni drangs par bgyi// zhi zhing thugs rje che ldan pa// dul zhing bsam gtan sa la bzhugs// chos dang ye shes chags bral ba// kun tu mi bzad nus par ldan// tshur spyon tshur spyon zhi dag la// thub pa skyes mchog thams cad mkhyen// shin tu legs byas gzugs brnyan ni// mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// 'dir ni gzugs dang lhan cig tu// 'gro ba'i don du bzhugs nas kyang*// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// mchog rnams legs par stsal du gsol// zhes pas sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad spyan drangs par mos/

khrus gsol phyag len ltar byas la/ khyed kyi rang bzhin yongs dag pas// srid pa'i 'ching ba mi mnga' yang*// bdag cag sgrib pa sbyang slad du// gtsang ma'i chab kyis sku khrus gsol/ zhes dang*/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol// oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ kā ya bi sho dha na ye swā hā/ zhes pas sku phyi'o// de nas de la kha dog legs bsgyur ba'i// na bza' shin tu dri zhim dam pa 'bul// gos bzang srab la 'jam pa sna tshogs dang*// rgyan mchog brgya phrag de dang de dag 'bul// oṃ badz+ra was+t+ra a laṃ ka ra pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ gis gos rgyan phul/ bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir// nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul mthu yis ni// ji srid mchod pa bdag bgyid na// de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol// oṃ badz+ra ā sa na pad+ma ka ma la ye s+t+waṃ/ oṃ ār+ya tā re sa pa ri wā ra puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke /gan+dhe/ nai wīd+ya pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ nyer spyod lngas mchod/ lha dang lha min cod pan gyis// zhes sogs kyis bstod/ lag gnyis mnyam pa'i thal mo las gung mo gnyis rtse sbyar ba'i tshigs gsum par mdzub mo'i rtse mo bkug la bzhag /mthe bong gnyis gshib ste mnyam du bsgreng*/ srin mdzub nang du bcug /mthe'u chung sbyar nas brkyangs pa ut+pal kha bye ba'i phyag rgya bcings te/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ ye shes pa dang dam tshig pa gnyis med du 'dres par gyur/ bzlas pa bya ba ni/ mdun bskyed rje btsun ma gtso 'khor rnams kyi thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du tām̐ yig ljang gu'i mtha' mar yi ge bcu pa'i sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyi 'jigs pa brgyad dang bcu drug sogs mi mthun pa'i phyogs zhi nas tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor 'dod dgu mtha' dag 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur/

ces dmigs la/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re swā hā/ rtsa sngags ji ltar 'os pa longs skabs dang bstun te bzla'o// gsum pa mchod bstod gtor 'bul sogs lan gsum bya dgos pa'i thog mar mchod pa byin brlab ni/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi byin gyis brlabs pa'i stobs dang bdag gi bsod nams dang smon lam gyi stobs dang*/ rig sngags kyi stobs kyis sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rnams la mchog tu rgya chen po byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa las mngon par mtho ba'i mchod pa'i sprin chen po rab tu 'phro bar gyur cig /ces dang*/ na maḥsarba bud+dha bo dhi satwa nāṃ sarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ sa man+ta swā hā/ zhes sngags lan brgyad brjod la/ 'jig rten khams ni dpag med na// mchod yon ji snyed yod pa dang*// bdag gis gus par bshams pa 'di// rgyal ba'i yum la mchod par bgyi// oṃ ār+ya tā re sa pa ri wa ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ tshigs bcad dang sngags kyi thog mtha' 'dra ba la/ mchod yon gyi gnas su/ me tog /bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo/ zhes dang*/ ar+ghaṃ gyi gnas su/ puṣ+pe sogs/ zhes bcug pa dang*/ yid 'ong khang brtsegs khrus kyi rdzing*// skyed mos tshal dang rin chen bdun// khri stan 'phan gdugs rgyal mtshan sogs// nam mkha'i khams kun bkang ste 'bul// oṃ sarba bi shiṣ+ṭha pū dza me gha pra sa ra sa mu dre āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas mchod/ bcom ldan 'das ma gtso 'khor gyi phyag g.yas skyabs sbyin mdzad pa'i 'og tu bsrung bya 'khor bcas tshud par bsams la/ oṃ rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo// phyag 'tshal tā re myur ma dpa' mo// tut+tā re yis 'jigs pa kun sel// tu res don kun grub pa'i sgrol ma// swā hā'i yi ger bcas la rab 'dud// phyag 'tshal sgrol ma myur ma dpa' mo// zhes pa nas/

phyag 'tshal ba ni nyi shu rtsa gcig /gi bar brjod/ yang*/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho dpag med na// mchod rdzas ji snyed yod pa dang*// bdag gis gus pas bshams pa 'di// rgyal ba'i yum la mchod par bgyi// oṃ ār+ya tā re sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pād+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhu pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai bid+ya shab+ta pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ zhes mchod/ sngar bzhin phyag 'tshal nyer gcig tshar gcig brjod/ de lta bu'i mchod bstod lan bdun rdzogs nas/ lha mo la gus yang dag ldan pas// sogs phan yon tshar gcig brjod/ ༈ de nas gtor ma cha gsum gyi dang po sgrol ma gtso 'khor la 'bul ba ni/ chab bran la/ gtor ma'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i tām̐ ljang gu de las 'od zer 'phros pas sems can gyi don byas nas tshur 'dus/ snod la thim pas yangs shing rgya che ba dang*/ bcud la thim pas lha rdzas kyi gtor ma bdud rtsir gyur/par bsam/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlabs/ mdun bskyed kyi bcom ldan 'das ma 'khor bcas kyi ljags 'od zer gyi sbu gu can gyis gtor ma gsol bas mnyes par gyur/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re swā hā/ a kā ro sogs btags pa lan bdun nam nyer gcig gis phul la/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma 'dod yon ma tshang ba med pa dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i gtor ma zag med ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po 'dzad pa med pa 'di nyid rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma thugs rje'i bdag nyid can nyi shu rtsa gcig la sogs pa yi dam rgyud sde bzhi dang theg pa rim dgu'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang*/ bstan pa dang 'khor rnam bzhi skyong bar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i phyi nang gi dam can chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs ma lus pa rnams dang*/

nor lha gter bdag dang bcas pa rnams la 'bul bar bgyi'o// bzhes nas rkyen phyi nang gi bar chad thams cad nye bar zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa'i don thams cad chos dang mthun pa yid bzhin du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la tshogs gnyis rdzogs/ sgrib gnyis byang nas myur du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par mdzad du gsol/ na mo/ bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dag dang*// de bzhin gshegs pa'i sbyin stobs dang*// chos kyi dbyings kyi stobs rnams kyis// don rnams gang dag bsam pa kun// de dag thams cad ci rigs pa// 'jig rten khams 'dir ma lus pa// thogs pa med par 'byung gyur cig /ces brjod rol mo dang bcas pas gtor ma dang po rten gyi drung du phul la/ rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma dang*// sogs nas/ kun nas dang bas phyag bgyi'o// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta pra na me ṇa badz+ra bhan+da naṃ ka ro mi/ zhes phyag 'tshal zhing*/ me tog bdug spos mar me dri// zhes pa nas/ 'phags ma'i tshogs kyis bzhes su gsol// gyi bar dang*/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ nas/ nai wid+ya'i bar nyer spyod dang*/ oṃ sarba bi shiṣ+ṭha pū dza me gha pra sa ra sa mu dre āḥhūm̐/ gis 'phan gdugs rgyal mtshan rin chen sna bdun la sogs pas mchod pa'i rjes su/ thog ma med nas da lta'i bar// zhes pa nas/ 'dren pa'i dpal du bdag gyur cig /ces pa'i bar dang*/ rje btsun bcom ldan 'das ma thugs rje can// sogs kyang brjod// skabs 'dir rang lugs kyi chos skyong gtor 'bul byed par 'dod na'ang rgyas bsdus gang 'grub bya bar gsungs pas spro na bya/ ma byas kyang gzhung gi dngos don min pas do gal med do// gang ltar gsol ba gdab pa ni/ thal mo spyi bor sbyar te yid brtan po'i sgo nas tshig 'di dag brjod do// na mo/ 'phags pa dkon mchog gsum gyi mthu dang*/

gsang sngags gzungs sngags rig sngags kyi mthu dang*/ yi dam zhi ba khro bo rnams kyi mthu dang*/ khyad par du 'phags ma sgrol ma thugs rje'i bdag nyid can nyi shu rtsa gcig gi mthu dang*/ bstan pa rin po che bsrung zhing skyong bar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i dam can chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi mthu dang*/ chos nyid rnam par dag cing chos can rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i mthu dang*/ bdag gis gtan pa med pa'i mchod sbyin rgya chen po bgyis pa'i mthu stobs nus pa la brten nas/ lha dang klu dang*/ grul bum dang dri za dang*/ sha za dang*/ srul po dang*/ smyo byed dang*/ brjed byed dang*/ de dag rgan po dang rgan mo dang*/ de dag gi bu pho dang bu mo dang*/ 'khor pho dang 'khor mo dang*/ mngag pa dang*/ gzhan yang ma mo mkha' 'gro dang*/ log 'dren thams cad dang*/ gshin rje dang rgyal po dang*/ 'gong po dang*/ nam mkha' lding dang*/ gnyan dang sa bdag dang*/ klu srin rnams dang*/ gnod sbyin dang*/ 'byung po thams cad dang*/ btsan bdud rnams dang*/ yi dwags rnams dang*/ drang srong dang rig sngags 'chang ba thams cad dang*/ gza' dang rgyu skar dang*/ lo dang zla ba dang*/ zhag dang za ma la sogs pa thams cad dang*/ gdon bgegs chen po'i rigs thams cad kyi sbyor ba ngan pas gnod pa'i bsam sbyor ngan pa thams cad zhi bar gyur cig /med par gyur cig /mi 'byung bar gyur cig /phyin chad mi byed par dam chos shig /de'i phyir so so'i 'dod yon rnams kyang ster ro// bden pa'i chos kyang 'chad do// bdag cag dpon slob rgyu sbyor ba la/ mi nad dang phyugs nad dang*/ rmi lam ngan pa dang*/ ltas ngan pa dang*/ bkra mi shis pa dang*/ byad ka dang*/ phur kha dang*/ gtad khram dang*/ lo skag dang*/ zla skag dang*/ zhag skag dang*/ dus kyi skag dang*/ lo nyes dang*/ than chen dang*/ btsa' dang*/ sad dang*/ ser ba dang*/ jag rkun dang*/ nad sri dang*/ 'chi sri dang*/ che sri dang*/ chung sri dang*/

dar sri dang*/ rgan sri dang*/ dur sri dang*/ god kha dang god sri dang*/ byur dang mi kha dang*/ rbod gtong dang bsam sbyor ngan pa dang*/ bgegs dang log 'dren thams cad dang*/ dus ma yin par 'chi ba dang*/ nor dang longs spyod mi 'phel bar byed pa dang*/ bkra mi shis par byed pa thams cad dang*/ bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa'i lus ngag yid gsum la gnod par byed pa'i nad rigs gdon bgegs/ bar chad dang rkyen ngan/ dgra 'dre byur gsum gyi gnod pa thams cad zhi bar gyur cig /med par gyur cig /phyir zlog par gyur cig /phyin chad mi 'byung bar gyur cig /thal mo brdab la rol mo drag tu bya ba'i mthar/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi byin gyis brlabs pa'i stobs dang*/ tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i mnga' thang chen po dang*/ chos kyi dbyings rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag cing*/ chos can rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i stobs kyis de de bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig /ces brjod/ des mchod bstod dang gtor ma cha dang po grub/ ༈ gnyis pa la slar yang mchod pa kha gso/ byin brlab nas brtsam/ tshar dang po la rgyas pa dang*/ phyi ma rnams la mchod tshig bsdus pa'i mchod pa/ phyag 'tshal nyer gcig gi bstod pa sbrel ba lan bdun gyi mthar phan yon bcas grub nas/ gtor ma gnyis pa 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs nas/ oṃ a kā ro sogs lan bdun brjod pa'i rjes su/ rang rang gi yid dang mthun pa'i gtor ma 'dod yon phun sum tshogs pa thams cad nam mkha' mdzod bzhin du 'dzad pa med pa 'di nyid bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu/ byis pa'i gdon chen bco lnga*/ nad bdag yams bdag gdon bgegs 'byung po'i rigs su gyur pa thams cad dang*/ 'gro ba rigs drug lam rgyud lnga skye gnas bzhis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad la sbyin no/ so so'i bsam pa dang mthun pa'i longs spyod zad mi shes pa ji srid 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig

/thams cad sdug bsngal las thar nas rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che myur du thob pa'i skal pa dang ldan par gyur cig /thams cad nam mkha' mdzod bzhin du// longs spyod zad pa med par shog /rtsod pa med cing 'tshe med par// rang dbang du ni spyod par shog /na mo/ bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dag dang*// sogs nas/ thogs pa med par 'byung gyur cig /zhes pa'i bar gong bzhin brjod la gtor ma mdos nang phul la rol mo bya/ de nas thal mo mgrin pa'i thad du sbyar la/ na mo/ 'phags pa dkon mchog gsum gyi mthu dang*/ sogs nas thal mo rdeb nas rol mo bya ba dang*/ de de bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig /ces pa'i bar gong bzhin brjod do// des mchod bstod gtor ma cha gnyis pa grub/ ༈ gsum pa la yang mchod pa kha gso/ byin brlab nas mchod bstod rgyas bsdus 'don lugs snga ma bzhin tshar bdun phan yon dang bcas pa song nas/ gtor ma gsum pa 'bru gsum gyis byin brlab/ oṃ a kā ro sogs lan gsum gyis bsngos nas/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya phun sum tshogs pa so so'i yid dang mthun pa'i longs spyod zad pa med pa 'di nyid bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi tshe rabs 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas tha ma da lta la thug gi bar du nyon mongs pa dug gsum dang dug lnga'i dbang gis brkus shing 'phrog pas nor dbul ba'i lan chags/ brdung zhing btsog pas nad dang 'tshe ba'i lan chags/ bsad cing gtub pa srog bcad pas tshe thung ba'i lan chags/ mtho ba'i mkhar phab pa/ dma' ba'i yul bcom pa/ mi rta grir bsad pa/ sngon gyi lan chags pa la sogs pa'i lan chags dang sha 'khon gyi bdag po bdag mo thams cad la sbyin no// gnod byed gdon bgegs lan chags kyi rigs su gyur pa thams cad tshims par gyur cig /ngoms par gyur cig /tshe rabs thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i lan chags thams cad byang bar gyur cig

/bu lon sod par gyur cig /sha 'khon dang phog thugs su gyur pa thams cad zhi bar gyur cig /bsam ngan dang gnod sems gdug rtsub thams cad dang bral nas phan pa dang zhi ba byang chub kyi sems dang ldan par gyur cig /mthar thug rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che myur du thob pa'i skal pa dang ldan par gyur cig /thams cad nam mkha' mdzod bzhin du// sogs nas/ na mo/ bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dag dang*// sogs gong ltar du brjod pas/ rol mo dang bcas pas gtor ma mdos nang du phul lo// de nas thal mo snying gar sbyar la yid brtan pa'i ngang nas/ na mo/ 'phags pa dkon mchog gsum gyi mthu dang*/ sogs nas thal mo brdeb la rol mo bcas/ de de bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig /bar gong bzhin brjod pas cha gsum pa grub/ ༈ gtor ma bzhi pa gzhi bdag dkar gtor mdos kyi lam sel gyi tshul du bsngo ba yin pas/ spro na gser skyems dkar gtor spyi 'gro rgyas pa skabs 'dir sbyar chog /bsdu na 'bru gsum gyis byin brlab/ a kā ro lan gsum gyis bsngo*/ sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing*// dge ba phun sum tshogs pa spyad// rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul// 'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin// ces chos sbyin byas la/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di gnas bdag gzhi bdag yul bdag grong bdag gnyug mar gnas pa rnams la 'bul lo// sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba dang*/ 'jig rten du dge legs rgya chen po 'byung zhing*/ bdag cag dpon slob sbyin bdag 'khor bcas kyi 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi zhing bsam sbyor chos mthun yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i stong grogs mdzod cig /ces pa tsam brjod la mdos phul phyogs su bskyal bas 'thus so/ ༈ bzhi pa mdos glud snang srid la brdzangs shing bsngo ba la/ thog mar sngags drug phyag drug gis mdos byin gyis brlab pa ni/ mdos chu gtsang gis bran la/

bdag nyid bcom ldan shākya thub// phyag rgya'i yi ge a dkar las// 'od 'phros gtor rdzas dngos 'dzin gyi// dri ma sbyangs nas stong par gyur// thal mo khong stong sbyar la/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhoḥsarba dharmaḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ/ lan gsum re re bzhin phyag rgya bkrol nas se gol gtogs pa gzhan rnams la'ang 'gre/ chos dbyings rnam dag phyag rgya sngags// ting 'dzin bden pas gtor rdzas kyi// 'bag rtsog nyams grib nyes skyon dang*// mtshan 'dzin dri ma dag gyur cig /bdag nyid bcom ldan rnam snang mdzad// phyag rgya'i yi ge kham̐ sngon las// 'od 'phros gtor rdzas zag med mdzod// nam mkha'i khams kun khyab par gyur// thal mo sbubs stong du sbyar ba'i tshig bar pa rnams bcag pa rin chen sgrom bu'i phyag rgya smin mtshams su bskor zhing*/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya sngags// ting 'dzin bden pas gtor rdzas rnams// bskal pa'i bar du zad mi shes// rgya chen nam mkha' gang gyur cig /bdag nyid bcom ldan bdud rtsi 'khyil// phyag rgya'i yi ge hrīḥdamar las// 'od 'phros gtor rdzas ye shes kyi// bdud rtsi chen po'i rang bzhin gyur// mthe bong bsnol/ sor mo gzhan rnams gshog pa ltar gdengs pa kha'i thad du bzhag la/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ bdud rtsi thabs sbyor phyag rgya sngags// ting 'dzin bden pas gtor rdzas rnams// bdud rtsi ye shes lnga yi dngos// 'chi gsos dug lnga'i sman gyur cig /bdag nyid bcom ldan rin chen 'byung*// phyag rgya'i yi ge trām̐ ser las// 'od 'phros gtor rdzas 'dod yon lnga// so so'i mos pa ji bzhin gyur// lag pa gnyis mdzub mo bsgrengs pa'i khu tshur g.yon snying gar bzhag /g.yas brkyang ste rdzas la gtod pa'i tshul byas la/

na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūm̐/ rgya chen shugs ldan phyag rgya sngags// ting 'dzin bden pas gtor rdzas rnams// dbang po'i spyod yul tshim byed pa'i// 'dod yon sna tshogs char 'baibs shog /bdag nyid bcom ldan don yod grub// phyag rgya'i yi ge ha ljang las// 'od 'phros mchog dman skal pa bzhin// 'thab rtsod med par thob par gyur// lag g.yas rdo rje khu tshur snying gar bcas/ g.yon pas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgyas snod 'degs pa'i tshul byas la/ oṃ dzñā na a ba lo ki te sa man+ta s+pha ra ṇa rasmi bha ba sa ma ya ma hā ma ṇi du ru du ru hri da ya dz+wa la ni hūm̐/ ye shes skar mda'i phyag rgya sngags// ting 'dzin bden pas mgron rnams kun// pham rgyal 'khrug rtsod med par thob// dgyes shing re ba skong gyur cig /bdag nyid bcom ldan rdo rje 'dzin// phyag rgya'i yi ge dza dmar las// 'od 'phros mgron rnams dbang du sdus// phrin las gang 'dod sgrub par gyur// lag gnyis sor mo bsnol ba'i khu tshur ngos mthe bong gnyis gshibs te brkyang pa spyi bor bskor te/ na maḥs man+ta bud+dhaḥnāṃ gra he shwa ri pra bhañtsa dza ti ma hā sa ma ya swā hā/ dbang bsgyur 'khor lo'i phyag rgya sngags// ting 'dzin bden pas mgron rigs kun// bdag gi dbang 'dus gang bcol las// sgrub pa'i sdong grogs mdzad gyur cig /mthar/ na mo/ bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dag dang*// de bzhin gshegs pa'i sbyin stobs dang*// chos kyi dbyings kyi stobs rnams kyis// lan chags mgron rnams brngan pa dang*// sems can kun la phan gdags slad// don rnams gang dag bsam pa kun// de dag thams cad ci rigs pa// 'jig rten khams ni ma lus pa// thogs pa med par 'byung gyur cig /ces bden pa'i stobs kyis kyang byin gyis brlab/ bye brag dmigs pa'i khyad par dbye zhing bsngo ba ni/

a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ mdun du rin po che las grub pa'i ri rab bang rim bzhi pa'i dbus su khang bzang lcags ris bskor ba'i mtha' bskor dang ri rab bang rim gyi steng rnams su mgron rnams so sor mnyes pa'i mthun rdzas 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yi longs spyod 'dzad pa med pa sa dang nam mkha' bar snang khyab par gyur/par bsam la/ sam+bha ra'i sngags lan bdun dang*/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rgyal ba rin chen mang la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa gzugs mdzes dam pa la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa sku 'byams klas la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa 'jigs pa thams cad yongs su bral ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ gsang sngags 'di'i mthu dang de bzhin gshegs pa khyed rnams kyi mtshan nas brjod cing phyag 'tshal ba'i byin rlabs la brten nas bdag gis gtan pa med pa'i mdos gtor rgya chen po bgyis pa 'di'i mthus mgron rigs thams cad tshims zhing mgu nas bdag gzhan gyi bsam pa'i don thams cad chos dang mthun pa yid bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig /de nas skabs 'dir yi dam drag po bskyed par bshad pas/ bdag nyid skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das pad+ma dbang chen sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas pas seng ldeng gi dbyug to nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon thugs kar sdig mdzub mdzad pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum sdang mig tu bgrad cing zhal nas mche ba bzhi rnam par gtsigs pa/ smin ma dang sma ra dmar ser dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar ba/ dbu skra kham ser gyen du brdzes pa/ spyi gtsug na rta mgo ljang gu rta skad 'byin pa/ klu chen po brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyangs pas ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na bzhugs nas gnod byed gdug pa can dang*/ sdig sgrib thams cad sreg par byed pa che btsan 'gran zla dang bral ba'i skur gyur/

mdun bskyed sgrol ma 'khor bcas kyang gzu dang dpang la bzhugs nas/ bdag gis ji ltar bsngos shing zlog sgyur brjod pa'i phrin las mdzad pas mgron thams cad kyis bka' nyan cing phrin las myur du sgrub par gyur/ ces pa'i nga rgyal ma bral bar rol mo dbyangs dang bcas te 'di skad do// hūm̐/ gson cig dgongs shig thams cad nyon// rtsa brgyud bla ma thams cad kyis// do nub zlog sgyur mdzad du gsol// yi dam lha tshogs thams cad kyis// do nub zlog sgyur mdzad du gsol// rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma kun// do nub zlog sgyur mdzad du gsol// ngan par gyur pa thams cad kun// myur du bzlog cing med par mdzod// dam can chos skyong srung ma rnams// 'dir ni bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod// mdos gtor mchod sbyin glud dang bcas// 'di rnams khyer la gnod ma byed// snang srid lha 'dre sde brgyad sogs// sngags 'chang bdag gi ngag la nyon// gzhan gyis rbad la ma nyon cig /gdon bgegs chen po khyed rnams kyi// bsam sbyor ngan pa zhi bar gyis// khyod la dgos pa'i gtor ma dang*// srog chags nor glud mang po dang*// la rdzas lung rdzas 'dod rgur bcas// yid 'ong khang pa spre'u zhol dang*// yid 'ong rta pho che mgyogs la// 'bru yi ngar mi chen po skyon// lus la gser g.yu'i rgyan cha btags// rgyan cha yid 'ong si li li// dar gyi gos gyon lhubs se lhub// smra ba mkhas shing bzhin mdangs rgyas// 'og na rta zhon zhungs se zhung*// mgo la thod bcings pu ru ru// rtsed 'jo sna tshogs bsgyur la mkhas// g.yu yi lham chung zu lu lu// gser gyi sked chings khru lu lu// nam rgyang ldem pas sku la brgyan// pho gdong mo gdong mi skad smra// mnga' ris 'dod rgu tshang ba rnams// yon bdag glud du khyod la 'jal// yid 'ong nor ni mang po dang*// zhal zas zhim dgu mngar bcu dang*// 'khor g.yog ngar mi sum cu dang*// sman spos sgron me gsal ba rnams// khyod la mchod pa 'bul lags kyis// dwang ba'i sems kyis bzhes nas su// sngags pas phur bu bsgril ba dang*// yungs kar thun du brab pa dang*// zor kha sna tshogs 'phen pa dang*// mnan gtad sbyor ba byed pa rnams// de dag nus pa phyir la zlog

/bon pos rnga chen brdung ba dang*// sngo dmar 'ur rdo 'phen pa dang*// rtsod sdig byed pa phyir la zlog /drag sngags phra men byed pa dang*// sde brgyad drag pos bskul ba rnams// de dag nus pa phyir la zlog /chos skyong lha 'dre thams cad kyang*// la la dkor gyi shul du 'brang*// la la mna' zan gshed du 'ong*// la la sngags pa drag pos rbad// la las ston pa'i rgyu 'bras ston// la las rims nad dal yams gtong*// char pa mi 'baib lo nyes gtong*// 'ga' zhig sad dang ser ba gtong*// lan chags bu lon 'ded pa dang*// nye 'brel grogs kyi shul 'brang dang*// mdze nad gtong ba'i klu rnams dang*// gnod byed lan chags lha 'dre rnams// sha khrag srog dbugs za ba dang*// 'bras bu lo thog za ba dang*// ngar snabs mi gtsang za ba dang*// 'byung ba'i lha dang sa bdag dang*// lo dang spar kha sme bar bcas// kun kyang glud kyis mnyes gyur cig /gnod 'gal ngan pa zhi bar mdzod// bu lon lan chags dag par bcol// bdag cag longs spyod 'phel bar mdzod// rbod gtong byad kha zlog tu gsol// bsam pa'i don rnams 'grub par mdzod// snying rje'i stobs kyis dam chos bshad// khyod kyang ma rig 'khor bar 'khyams// da ni byang sems ldan par gyis// rang gi lus la dpe longs la// gzhan la gnod pa ma skyel bar// sdig spangs thar pa'i lam la snyogs// rang sems chos sku'i rang zhal la// 'dzin med yengs med rgyun du ltos// stong nyid snying rje'i ngang nyid las// nad dang dal yams zhi bar mdzod// lo legs char chu dus su phob// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// snga dgra sdar dang da dgra rtsub// phyi dgra shom pa thams cad zlog /glo bur brgyad cu rtsa gcig zlog /ye 'drog sum brgya drug cu zlog /bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad rnams zlog /stong phrag brgyad cu'i bgegs rnams zlog /ya bdud g.yos dang dam sri longs// ma bdud ma tshan rgyab 'dre dang*// ma bu'i byur 'dre bzlog tu gsol// sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs// thams cad ma lus bzlog tu gsol// lo zla zhag dus ngan pa bzlog

/phung 'dre thams cad bzlog tu gsol// ltog 'dre thams cad bzlog tu gsol// sri la brku ba bzlog tu gsol// byis pa'i gdon rnams zlog tu gsol// phyugs kyi gdon rnams zlog tu gsol// mi kha kha smras ma gtong cig /gzhan gyi g.yul ngo zhi ba dang*// bdag gi dmag thabs legs par mdzod// dgra jag chom rkun zhi bar mdzod// myos shing 'thib pa sel ba dang*// nyin gcig gnyis gsum bdun pa yi// rims nad thams cad zhi bar mdzod// nyam nga 'tshe ba bzlog tu gsol// ngan dang rtsub pa'i rigs rnams kun// da lta nyid du zlog tu gsol// yul phyogs dge bar mdzad du gsol// dam chos rgyas par mdzad du gsol// 'thab rtsod zhi bar mdzad du gsol// lo brgya 'tsho bar mdzad du gsol// ston brgya mthong bar mdzad du gsol// bkra shis ri bo brtan pa dang*// bsod nams nam mkha' nyi 'od drang*// mi phyed mi shigs dngos grub stsol// zhes brjod pas lam du bskyal bcol la/ rang gis nang nas 'og tu bshad pa'i bden stobs brjod/ zlog pa 'di tshar grangs gsum sogs bskyar 'dod na'ang bya chog /yang na rims nad gcod pa sogs gal che dus phyi rol du gto rgyab byed na 'phen phyogs su dar nag dang rol mo bcas te khyer/ de'ang nad yams dal phyogs lam mdos sogs/ byad kha dang dgra bgegs la de phyogs/ than chen char 'bebs la chu mgo'am mtsho 'gram du bskyel ba sogs rig pas dpyad/ thog mar dkar gtor dang gser skyems spyi 'gro rgyas par btang*/ de nas bden stobs brjod pa tsam gyis chog kyang*/ spro na gong smos zlog bsgyur de tshar gcig /lnga pa bden stobs kyis bzlog pa ni/ mdos gtor gnam du btegs la rang nyid yi dam kyi nga rgyal brtan pa dang*/ sgrol ma sogs kyi gzu dpang dang rgyab brten gsal ba'i ngang nas bden stobs brjod cing mdos bzlog bya ba ni/ na mo/ 'phags pa dkon mchog gsum gyi mthu dang*/

sogs nas/ phyin chad mi 'byung bar gyur cig /bar gong ltar brjod pa'i mthar/ sngags pas phur bu bsgril ba dang*/ yungs kar thun du brab pa dang*/ zor kha mnan gtad byed pa dang*/ de dag gi nus mthu thams cad phyir bzlog tu gsol/ bon pos rnga chen brdung ba dang*/ sngo dmar 'ur rdo 'phen pa dang*/ rtsod sdig byed pa dang*/ drag sngags phra men byed pa dang*/ sde brgyad dregs pa bskul ba dang*/ de dag gi nus mthu thams cad phyir bzlog tu gsol/ chos skyong dang lha 'dre rnams dkor gyi shul du phreng ba dang*/ mna' zan gshed du 'ong ba/ sngags pa drag pos rbad pa/ bden pa'i rgyu 'bras ston pa/ rims nad yams nad gtong ba/ char med than chen gtong ba/ lo nyes btsa' dang sad ser gtong ba/ lan chags bu lon snyegs pa/ nye 'brel dang grogs kyi shul du 'brang ba/ klu nad dang mdze nad dang shu ba gtong ba/ de dag gi nus mthu thams cad phyir zlog tu gsol/ sha khrag srog dbugs 'phrog pa/ khe tshol glag lta ba/ yid 'gab pa/ lo zla zhag dus kyi skag rtsub pa/ spar kha dang sme ba rtsub pa/ lus dang kha rje dbang thang zhan pa/ bla gnas dang klung rta rgud pa thams cad phyir zlog tu gsol/ nad rims me ltar mched pa/ ltas ngan mun ltar 'thib pa/ rmis ltas mtshan ma ngan pa thams cad phyir bzlog tu gsol/ nad rigs bzhi brgya dang brtsa bzhi bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu zlog tu gsol/ glo bur brgyad cu rtsa gcig gi gnod pa thams cad phyir zlog tu gsol/ byis pa'i gdon chen bco lnga*/ ya bdud rgyal po'i gnod pa/ ma bdud 'dre mo'i gnod pa/ dam log dam sri'i gnod pa/ pha tshan gyi rgyab 'dre/ ma bu'i byur 'dre/ dgu mig dang*/ dur mig dang*/ bzhi gshed drug 'gram bdun zur phyogs ngan bdud gcod sdang dgra gnod byed thams cad phyir zlog tu gsol/ lo zla zhag dang za ma'i skag ngan phung 'dre phung sri/ dbul sri mi la bse rag ltog 'dre 'gong po phyugs kyi god kha thams cad phyir zlog tu gsol/

dpal la 'jab pa/ sri la rku ba/ dmag sna rkun sna jag sna zug pa thams cad phyir zlog tu gsol/ dran pa mi gsal ba rmug cing 'thib pa/ mi kha dang kha smras gtong ba/ nyin mo'i ltas ngan pa/ mtshan mo'i rmi lam ngan pa thams cad phyir zlog tu gsol/ tshe 'di'i rkyen dang byur/ dam pa'i chos sgrub pa'i gegs/ phyi ma'i sa lam la gnod pa'i 'gal rkyen bar du gcod pa thams cad phyir zlog tu gsol/ mdor na bkra mi shis pa'i rigs su gyur pa gang yin pa de dag thams cad bdag la sdang dgra gnod byed bsam ngan sbyor rtsub/ do bsdo phod 'dzug bsam ngan log par lta bar byed pa'i steng du da lta nyid du phyir sgyur ro// phyir zlog go /bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la legs pa'i yon tan mtha' dag 'bad med lhun grub tu zla ba yar gyi ngo ltar 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ ces brjod mdos bzlog 'phen/ thu ba brdab/ sum+bha ni sogs drag sngags gang shes brjod/ mthar zlog bya zlog byed dang bral ba'i ngang la dmigs med yun ring bzhag la rol mo bya/ de nas dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang*/ sogs nas/ de de bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig /bar brjod/ ye shes kyi khro bo'i sprul pa bya khyung mthing nag rab tu 'bar bas zhal phar gzigs te 'byung po'i phyir snyogs nam yang mi thar ba'i rjes bcad par gyur/ khroṃ ga ru ṭa tsa le tsa le hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces gto yas kyi rjes phyir bcad/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ phaṭa/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa ba drwa ba gur bla bre dang bcas pa sra zhing brtan pa'i phyi rol du mtshon cha sna tshogs pa'i gur khang ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar zhing khro bo drag sngags sgrogs pa rdul ltar 'tshubs pas bskal pa'i rlung yang rgyu bar mi nus par gyur/ ces bsgoms la nang du log /srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du mdun bskyed sgrol ma 'khor dang bcas pa bzhugs pa'i skyabs sbyin phyag rgya'i 'og tu bdag cag bsrung bya 'khor bcas tshud pas bgegs dang bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal bar gyur par mos so/

༈ gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba ni/ mchod pa gsar du brje ba'am kha gsos la/ byin brlab nas bzung tshigs bcad dang sngags kyis 'bul ba gong smos ltar rgyas par bya/ phyag 'tshal nyer gcig bstod pa tshar gcig gam gsum dang*/ phan yon bcas brjod/ rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma dang*// sogs yan lag bdun pa tshang bar byas la/ 'dod don gsol ba gdab pa ni/ oṃ/ 'grub par gyur cig rje btsun thugs rje can// 'phags ma khyod la bsnyen sgrub mchod pa dang*// bstod cing gsol ba btab pa'i mthu byin gyis// deng nas bzung ste byang chub ma thob bar// 'phags ma khyod dang rtag tu mi 'bral zhing*// nad med tshe dbang longs spyod 'phel ba dang*// byang chub sgrub la bar chad mi 'byung zhing*// sa dang lam gyi yon tan rab rdzogs nas// bdag gzhan don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa yi// rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par shog /bzod gsol ni/ yig brgya lan gsum dang*/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs/ de kun mgon pos bzod par mdzod// bdag cag so so'i skye bo bsam pa nyon mongs pa can du gyur pa'i dbang gis ting nge 'dzin mi gsal zhing bying rgod kyi dbang du gyur pa dang*/ yo byad la dbang ma thob pas mchod pa'i dngos po chung zhing ngan pa/ gtsang sbras ma phyed pa/ cho ga bzhin du ma lcogs pa la sogs pa nongs pa'i tshogs ci mchis pa thams cad 'phags pa thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa khyed rnams la bzod par gsol na bdag cag la 'phral dang yun du sgrib par mi 'byung bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ smon lam ni/ bsod nams 'di yis 'gro ba kun// rje btsun sgrol ma 'dra bar shog /bdag kyang ting 'dzin 'di bsgrubs pas// 'gro ba'i don du sangs rgyas shog /mdun bskyed rten med na/ oṃ/ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzod// rjes su mthun pa'i sogs kyis ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu/ 'dir rten dang khyad par sku gzugs yod pa'i dbang du byas nas/

spyan drangs pa'i ye shes pa rnams rten 'di dag la brtan par bzhugs nas sbyin pa'i bdag pos thog drangs sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā/ zhes brtan bzhugs byas la 'bru 'thor/ rang gi spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur/ ces pas sgo gsum bsrung ngo*// shis brjod ni/ ston mchog dam pa lha mi'i mchod 'os pa// sangs rgyas phyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legs shog /sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba// de dag thams cad deng 'dir bde legs shog /zhi ba chags bral lha mi'i mchod 'os pa// chos la phyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legs shog /sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba// de dag thams cad deng 'dir bde legs shog /tshogs kyi dam pa lha mi'i mchod 'os pa// dge 'dun phyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legs shog /sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba// de dag thams cad deng 'dir bde legs shog /'byung po gang dag 'dir ni lhags gyur tam// sa'am 'on te bar snang 'khod kyang rung*// skye rgu rnams la rtag tu byams byed cing*// nyin dang mtshan mo chos la spyod par shog /bdag dang sbyin bdag 'khor dang bcas pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las shin tu rgyal zhing bkra shis par gyur cig /ces bkra shis brjod cing me tog gi char dang rol mo'i sgra bsgrag go /'di ni nyin chog bya ba'i tshul yin la/ zhag gsum mam bdun sogs bsgrub kyang rung bas zhag grangs byed na nyin phyi ma rnams la mchod pa gsar du brje/ 'bul gtor bzhi po nyin re bzhin bshams nas 'bul/ mdos bzlog kha gso ba tsam gyis chog /bdag bskyed nas mthud sa bcad bzhi pa mdos glud lha 'dre la bsngo ba rdzogs kyi bar btang la rjes chog mchod bstod man chad bya/ 'bul nyin mdos glud bsngo ba'i skabs mar me rnams sbar/

bden stobs kyis bzlog pa sogs gong smos ltar byas pas 'grub bo// spyir rje btsun sgrol ma'i mtshan dran pa tsam gyis 'jigs pa thams cad las skyob pa dang*/ bar chad thams cad zlog cing khyad par theg pa chen po pa rnams kyi lhag pa'i lha dang mgon skyob gcig pu pa yin pa dang*/ bod kha ba can gyi lha skal snyigs ma'i dus su byin rlabs lhag par myur ba yin pas bon lugs dang 'brel ba'i gto phran gzhan las kyang 'di nyid la 'bad rtsol nus na 'di phyi gnyis ka'i don chen po bde blag tu 'grub par 'gyur ba yin no// snyigs dus skye bo bsod nams dman// de las blo gros rgya chung bas// nor bu bor nas 'ching bu tshol// phug nor las kyang nyin lto 'dom// 'di 'dras don du 'gyur dka' yang*// rgyun srol mang du thos pas na// mi nub btsas su 'di byas dges// 'brel tshad 'phags mas rjes 'dzin shog /'di nyid dgos pa phan yon byin rlabs che bar mthong yang 'dir dar srol chung bas/ rang gzhan la phan 'dod kyi lhag pa'i bsam pas kun nas bslangs te/ rgya ston yi ge rtsa ba dang rgyal tshab grags pa mchog gi yig cha la gzhi byas/ yig cha gzhan las kyang legs pa'i cha blangs te/ yon tan rgya mtsho blo gros mtha' yas pa'i sdes dpal spungs yang khrod tsā 'dra rin chen brag gi sgrub gnas su bris pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba maṅga laṃ//
